name: Anthony Michael
player_statement:
A complete player, Anthony Michael has made a big mark in cricket. With 13 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 28, with an average of 13.10 and a quick strike rate of 131.00. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 5 sixes and 15 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 25.3 overs, taking 12 wickets at an economy rate of 7.76. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
